options.name: active
options.description: Whether the volume is active and visible to the host.

options.name: force
options.description: Shrink or remove operations of volumes requires this switch. Ensures that filesystems never get corrupted/destroyed by mistake.

options.name: lv
options.description: The name of the logical volume.

options.name: opts
options.description: Free-form options to be passed to the lvcreate command.

options.name: pvs
options.description: List of physical volumes (for example V(/dev/sda, /dev/sdb)).

options.name: resizefs
options.description: Resize the underlying filesystem together with the logical volume. Supported for C(ext2), C(ext3), C(ext4), C(reiserfs) and C(XFS) filesystems. Attempts to resize other filesystem types result in failure.

options.name: shrink
options.description: Shrink if current size is higher than size requested.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the logical volume, according to lvcreate(8) C(--size), by default in megabytes or optionally with one of [bBsSkKmMgGtTpPeE] units; or according to lvcreate(8) C(--extents) as a percentage of [VG|PVS|FREE|ORIGIN]; Float values must begin with a digit. When resizing, apart from specifying an absolute size you may, according to lvextend(8)|lvreduce(8) C(--size), specify the amount to extend the logical volume with the prefix V(+) or the amount to reduce the logical volume by with prefi

options.name: snapshot
options.description: The name of a snapshot volume to be configured. When creating a snapshot volume, the O(lv) parameter specifies the origin volume.

options.name: state
options.description: Control if the logical volume exists. If V(present) and the volume does not already exist then the O(size) option is required.

options.name: thinpool
options.description: The thin pool volume name. When you want to create a thin provisioned volume, specify a thin pool volume name.

options.name: vg
options.description: The volume group this logical volume is part of.
